b.onb.stores.unavailable: Store list unavailable ({errore}). You can skip this and connect them from Settings.
b.palette.footer: ↑↓ to choose · Enter to open · Esc to close
b.setup.hero.dataDir: Your data stays on this computer:
b.setup.hero.text: Your game library: console ROMs and PC games from stores, with cover art, descriptions, ratings, play times and suggestions. A few steps are enough; everything can be changed later in Settings.
b.setup.online.help: Even without an account, Pozzo Launcher recognizes games and finds data and cover art from offline sources (libretro, LaunchBox, TheGamesDB). Accounts add descriptions in Italian, critic scores and more images.
b.setup.pickNoBrowser: In the browser, paste the folder path into the field
b.setup.roms.help: Choose the folder that contains the console folders (e.g. snes, psx, Nintendo - Game Boy Advance…). Subfolders are searched too.
b.setup.roms.noRoms: I have no ROMs: I only want PC games from stores
b.setup.roms.none: No console folders recognized here. You can continue and assign them later from Settings › New games.
b.setup.roms.title: Where are your ROMs?
b.setup.stores.help: Import games from the stores installed on this computer. Accounts (Epic, GOG, Steam key for uninstalled games) can be connected later from Settings › Accounts.
b.setup.stores.title: PC games
b.setup.sum.background: (in the background: you can use the app meanwhile)
b.setup.sum.scrape: Look up game data and cover art right away
b.setup.sum.title: All set
b.splash.timeout: Timeout: the library isn't ready. You can continue and try again.
b.tour.end.text: Have fun! To replay the tour: Settings menu › Guided tour, or Settings › General › “Replay the tour”.
b.tour.end.title: You're all set
b.tour.game.text: Click a cover for details, double-click to play. Right-click to see other actions, such as favorites.
b.tour.game.title: A game
b.tour.keys.text: Press “{aiuto}” at any time to see all shortcuts. You'll also find them in the Settings menu.
b.tour.keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
b.tour.profile.text: Each person can have their own profile, with favorites and playtime. From here you can switch users.
b.tour.profile.title: Who's playing
b.tour.search.text: Type the title or developer. Press “{cerca}” to jump here from anywhere; with {palette} you open the quick search for games and commands.
b.tour.search.title: Search for a game
b.tour.settings.text: Here you'll find game folders, emulators, stores and all the other options.
b.tour.sort.text: Sort games by title, year or playtime. Nearby you'll find filters for genre, decade and language.
b.tour.sort.title: Sort and filter
b.tour.themes.text: In Settings › Appearance, hover over a theme to preview it without applying it; there you'll also find zoom, density and the color editor.
b.tour.themes.title: Themes and appearance
b.tour.toast.off: The tour won't start again. To replay it: Settings › General › “Replay the tour”, or Settings menu › Guided tour.
b.tour.top.text: “Big Picture” opens the library full screen, designed for a controller. “Random” picks a game for you.
b.tour.top.title: Big Picture and random game
b.tour.views.text: Choose what to look at here: all games, favorites, stores, consoles and your collections.
b.tour.views.title: Your views
b.tour.welcome.text: In a minute I'll show you where to find the most useful things. You can use the ← and → arrow keys and stop whenever you like.
b.tour.welcome.title: Welcome to Pozzo Launcher
